module_summary: Loadable up/down counter stepping by a delta each enabled cycle, with an extra MSB for transient overflow or an optional sticky overflow register.

anchors.name: counter_q
anchors.why: Width+1 counter register; loaded, incremented or decremented by delta.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Enables counting by delta each cycle.

anchors.name: load_i
anchors.why: Loads d_i into counter, overriding counting.

anchors.name: delta_i
anchors.why: Step amount added or subtracted each enabled cycle.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Counter value output from counter_q low bits.

anchors.name: overflow_o
anchors.why: Overflow indication from counter MSB or sticky register.

anchors.name: gen_sticky_overflow.overflow_q
anchors.why: Sticky overflow flag, only when StickyOverflow parameter set (disabled by default).

groups.name: overflow_detect
groups.description: Transient MSB or optional sticky overflow detection.
